genderHelp.trigger: How can I identify a noun's gender?
genderHelp.title: How can I identify the gender?
genderHelp.intro: In German, it is best to learn a noun together with its article: der, die, or das. The ending can help, but there are exceptions.
genderHelp.der: der: days, months, and seasons are often masculine; common endings include -ling, -ismus, and -or.
genderHelp.die: die: words ending in -ung, -heit, -keit, -schaft, -ion, and -tät are usually feminine.
genderHelp.das: das: words ending in -chen or -lein, and nouns formed from verbs, are often neuter.
genderHelp.compound: The gender of a compound word is usually determined by its last part. For example, die Haustür takes its gender from die Tür.
genderHelp.outro: If you are unsure, check the word in a dictionary. Learn each noun with its article and an example.
